description: Write a certificate, private key and CA chain into a folder on this host, in the 'named' layout (<basename>.crt/.key/.ca/.fullchain.crt) or the 'pem' layout (fullchain.pem + privkey.pem). Files are mode 640, the folder 750, optionally group-owned. Overwrites existing files in place. Set test to true to check that a deploy would work, changing nothing. The key_b64 argument is a PRIVATE KEY.

test.description: Check that a deploy would work and change nothing. When true, cert_b64, key_b64 and ca_b64 are not used.

target_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder to write into. Created if missing. Must not contain '..'.

basename.description: File name stem, usually the domain (example.com). Used by the 'named' layout; ignored in file names by 'pem'.

group.description: Group (name or numeric gid) to own the folder and files, so a service in that group can read the key. '-' leaves the group unchanged. For a container, the gid of the service user inside the container.

cert_b64.description: Base64 of the PEM certificate. Required unless test is true.

key_b64.description: SECRET: base64 of the PEM PRIVATE KEY. Required unless test is true. Visible in the process table while the script runs; handle as a secret.

ca_b64.description: Base64 of the PEM CA chain. Required unless test is true.
